exposure: Maternal risk factors during pregnancy and labor (e.g., meconium stained liquor, prolonged rupture of membrane)
Birth asphyxia (APGAR score at 5 minutes of < 7)
cohort: Term babies born during April 2013 to March 2014 in Nepal Medical College with an APGAR score at 5 minutes of < 7.
finding: The rate of birth asphyxia was 21.1/1000 live births, resulting in a mortality rate of 4.25% among asphyxiated newborns.
